title: 19 December 1964: George Harrison and Pattie Boyd return from the Bahamas
content:
George Harrison and Pattie Boyd returned to England from their holiday in Nassau in the Bahamas on this day. They had arrived on 9 December 1964.

The couple flew to London Airport from Nassau International Airport, two days prior to the beginning of rehearsals for Another Beatles Christmas Show at the Hammersmith Odeon, London.

Page last updated: 26 October 2022
